title: conventions-writer return
description: The conventions-writer's return object on either axis and every action. The caller builds its report from this object alone and never re-reads the document.

outcome.description: The document now stands written; carried over from the old action_taken value.

document_path.description: The absolute path of the one document written.

not_determined.description: The count of lines in the document's ## Not determined section.

not_determined_lines.description: Every ## Not determined line, verbatim, each Reviewer finding not applied line included; omitted when there is none.

conflicts.description: One item per contradiction between the adopter's harvested prose and the code inside this document's scope; omitted when there is none.

prose.description: What the adopter's harvested prose says, naming its source.

code.description: What the code does, naming the file and the symbol or quoted substring.

shared_document_divergences.description: One item per divergence between shared_document and this scope's code; always emitted, [] on pass: corpus, on shared_document: none and when nothing was found.

source.description: The file plus the symbol or quoted substring it was read off.

findings_applied.description: Fix dispatches only: the count of findings applied; omitted on a write dispatch.

findings_declined.description: One item per finding not applied; omitted when there is none.

finding.description: A forwarded divergence's line verbatim, its Layer-writer divergence prefix intact, or a reviewer finding's check_id where it has one followed by its claim.

evidence.description: One line naming what was read, and on a sampled repository what was not.

prior_document.description: What stood at document_path when the dispatch arrived.

prior_prompts.description: Every What belongs here item that file carried, verbatim, one per line; none or n/a.

prior_rule_block.description: The stack-independent rule block that file carried, verbatim; none or n/a.
